name: echo mic drop
description: Proposal, the mic drop gesture (a plain microphone, no brand, no words), 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x on a plank stage in a warm spotlight): an iris opens on the creature holding a silver microphone at its side, it blinks, swings its arm out to arm's length with the microphone up and its eyes gone flat and cool, an antenna ping, then opens its hand; the microphone falls faster each frame, lands on its handle with impact strokes and a ping, bounces up turning and comes down on its side with one small bounce more; the creature glances down at it, turns its face left and walks off the left edge, the microphone lies in the light, a glint, and the iris closes on it; judge whether the microphone reads as one at 12 px cells, whether the fall and the bounce read as weight, and whether it is still this creature.
